say:0:1421431001:0.text: What lies before you is more than just a document—it's an entire set of invalidated wills and orders.
say:0:1421431001:0.source_cn: 这封文书——更确切的说，这一整套被作废的“遗嘱”就这样...
say:0:1421431001:0.male: What lies before you is more than just a document—it's an entire set of invalidated wills and orders.
say:0:1421431001:0.female: What lies before you is more than just a document—it's an entire set of invalidated wills and orders.

document:1:190:0.text:
Will & Future Plan
Draconization has been significantly alleviated. After ruling out all other physical methods, such as incision and cutting, childbirth now remains the final hurdle.
Currently, the fetus has reached its maximum capacity, and the estimated delivery date is in two weeks.

Note: Inform Velara to be prepared.
Given the risks associated with both magic and childbirth, it is essential to establish a plan for the future.

- In the event of my death, Thador is to issue the order and work with ??? to eliminate Velara. It must be ensured that upon Velara's death, the throne passes to ???. Thador shall fully cooperate.
- If Velara survives, or if ??? refuses to help, Thador is to initiate immediate suppression of all information, and select a new successor to the throne.
- If Thador fails and Velara survives... such a possibility must be eliminated. A contingency must be left for Velara before the child is born.

The finalized version of this document will be drafted once Velara enters her recovery period.
document:1:190:0.source_cn:
关于遗嘱，草稿及方向性规划
龙化得到了极其有效的缓解，但在放弃物理手段（剖出、切割）的手法后，生育将成为最大阻碍。
目前胎儿已承载至极限，预测将在半个月内生产。
注：需通知奎茵准备
考虑到魔力及生育本身的风险，有必要预先订立此后的方向。
如果死亡，由都铎持手令，与▇▇▇▇一同排除奎茵，必须确保其身亡后，交由▇▇▇▇继承王位，都铎必须全力配合。
若排除失败，或▇▇▇▇反对，都铎第一时间进行封口，继承者由都铎挑选。
如都铎失败，奎茵幸存……必须排除此种可能性，生产前需要给奎茵留下后手。
具体撰文润色，待通知奎茵进入休养期间后进行。

say:2:1421431002:1.text: The queen's will, along with two equally lethal decrees for Velara and Thador, were recorded in Seralyth's detached precision.
say:2:1421431002:1.source_cn: 无论是对于自己的变化，留给奎茵与都铎两份截然不同却又杀...
say:2:1421431002:1.male: The queen's will, along with two equally lethal decrees for Velara and Thador, were recorded in Seralyth's detached precision.
say:2:1421431002:1.female: The queen's will, along with two equally lethal decrees for Velara and Thador, were recorded in Seralyth's detached precision.

say:5:1421431003:1.text: This will doesn't even mention the newborn child at all. Seralyth just—
say:5:1421431003:1.source_cn: 这封遗嘱，居然完全没有提到刚生出来的孩子该怎么办，奈萨...

say:6:1421431004:1.text: Oh, Indris, isn't it obvious? That baby was never part of the grand plan. It was just a... detoxification vessel. Its survival was always an afterthought.
say:6:1421431004:1.source_cn: 这很好理解啊，因度厄，你别忘了，这个婴儿是用于“排毒”...

say:7:1421431005:1.text: Even if it survived, it would probably be deformed due to the corruption.
say:7:1421431005:1.source_cn: 即使活着，也多半会伴随着诅咒与孽化的积累，呈现出可怕的畸形。

say:8:1421431006:1.text: And even if, against all odds, it was a healthy infant? Amidst the chaos of the queen's downfall, no one would spare it a passing glance.
say:8:1421431006:1.source_cn: 退一万步说，哪怕真是个健康的婴儿，在女王崩逝，政权交替...

choice_prompt:9:1421431006.text: And even if, against all odds, it was a healthy infant? Amidst the chaos of the queen's downfall, no one would spare it a passing glance.
choice_prompt:9:1421431006.source_cn: 退一万步说，哪怕真是个健康的婴儿，在女王崩逝，政权交替的时候，祂的生命可是最微不足道的。

say:10:1421431007:0.text: Precisely. The biggest obstacle here was actually Velara.
say:10:1421431007:0.source_cn: 没错，这里面最大的绊脚石其实就是奎茵。
say:10:1421431007:0.male: Precisely. The biggest obstacle here was actually Velara.
say:10:1421431007:0.female: Precisely. The biggest obstacle here was actually Velara.

say:11:1421431008:1.text: That fanatic would never have accepted some random heir if my mother truly died.
say:11:1421431008:1.source_cn: 作为我母亲的狂信徒，如果我母亲真的去世，她绝对不会选择...
say:11:1421431008:1.male: That fanatic would never have accepted some random heir if my mother truly died.
say:11:1421431008:1.female: That fanatic would never have accepted some random heir if my mother truly died.

say:12:1421431009:1.text: As long as I—her precious bloodline—still breathed, even as a half-rotted corpse, she'd have propped me up on the throne herself.
say:12:1421431009:1.source_cn: 但凡继承了她血统的我还有口气——没错，哪怕畸形或者孽化...
say:12:1421431009:1.male: As long as I—her precious bloodline—still breathed, even as a half-rotted corpse, she'd have propped me up on the throne herself.
say:12:1421431009:1.female: As long as I—her precious bloodline—still breathed, even as a half-rotted corpse, she'd have propped me up on the throne herself.

say:13:1421431010:0.text: Her loyalty was never to Sal'thorin. It was to Seralyth alone.
say:13:1421431010:0.source_cn: 的确，比起萨洛克兰和权力本身，她对你母亲更加忠诚。

say:14:1421431011:1.text: But she was too reckless, too extreme. She lacked my mother's cunning. And Thador? He would never have bent to her whims.
say:14:1421431011:1.source_cn: 但她与我母亲比，手段太过激进，想法又太单纯，都铎那个死...

say:15:1421431012:1.text: He's like one of those dwarven constructs—programmed to follow orders and nothing more. Which made him perfect for safeguarding a will.
say:15:1421431012:1.source_cn: 他就像那种没有指令就没法自己行动的矮人造物一样，所以遗...

say:16:1421431013:1.text: With one side clinging to the prince and the other the decree, the result was inevitable—endless debate and division.
say:16:1421431013:1.source_cn: 到时候一边手持王子一边手持遗诏，结局肯定是各种争论与分裂。

say:17:1421431014:1.text: So that's why the will commands Thador to kill Velara, instead of simply declaring she had no role in the queen's death?
say:17:1421431014:1.source_cn: 所以她才会在遗嘱里要求都铎干掉奎茵，而不是说明奎茵与她...

say:18:1421431015:1.text: …She used Velara's loyalty to set this all in motion, only to decide her fate in advance?
say:18:1421431015:1.source_cn: ……她一边利用奎茵的忠诚，让她帮自己进行这么隐秘而重要...

say:20:1421431016:1.text: Welcome to court politics. Look—even the name written here has been completely erased. Not just from family records, but from history itself.
say:20:1421431016:1.source_cn: 很正常，你看，▇▇这个名字，在我的记忆里已经彻底被抹除...

say:21:1421431017:1.text: Most likely, once my mother realized she wasn't dead and the child survived, she ordered Thador to carry it out.
say:21:1421431017:1.source_cn: 多半是母亲发现自己没死，孩子也没事，于是就命令都铎下手了吧。

say:22:1421431018:1.text: A queen facing death needs strong, popular allies.
say:22:1421431018:1.source_cn: 一个足以被岌岌可危的女王托付权力的人，想必是一位出色、...

say:23:1421431019:0.text: But a queen who recovers? Suddenly those same allies become threats.
say:23:1421431019:0.source_cn: 但在我们独断专行的女王陛下没有生命危险时，这一切优点可...

say:24:1421431020:1.source_cn: ……所谓的政治和权力，真是太肮脏了。

say:25:1421431021:1.text:
Thanks for the compliment.
Hmm... Seems there are no further records.
say:25:1421431021:1.source_cn: 多谢夸奖。\n唔……看样子没有更详细的记载了。

say:26:1421431022:1.text: With all these dwarven documents here, maybe this place was nothing more than a dumping ground for things meant to be buried.
say:26:1421431022:1.source_cn: 包括这些矮人文书在内，这里或许只是用于存放一些见不得光...

choice_prompt:27:1421431022.text: With all these dwarven documents here, maybe this place was nothing more than a dumping ground for things meant to be buried.
choice_prompt:27:1421431022.source_cn: 包括这些矮人文书在内，这里或许只是用于存放一些见不得光或者已经作废的东西？

say:28:1421431023:1.text: But Velara already—oh, you mean Thador?
say:28:1421431023:1.source_cn: 当事人……奎茵不是已经——你是说，都铎？
say:28:1421431023:1.male: But Velara already—oh, you mean Thador?
say:28:1421431023:1.female: But Velara already—oh, you mean Thador?

say:29:1421431024:0.text: Indeed. That man has done so much of my mother's dirty work, he must know plenty of interesting details.
say:29:1421431024:0.source_cn: 嗯，的确，那家伙既然替我母亲干过这么多脏活儿，那多半会...
say:29:1421431024:0.male: Indeed. That man has done so much of my mother's dirty work, he must know plenty of interesting details.
say:29:1421431024:0.female: Indeed. That man has done so much of my mother's dirty work, he must know plenty of interesting details.

say:30:1421431025:1.text: As I recall, you were kind enough to let him live, weren't you, Indris?
say:30:1421431025:1.source_cn: 我记得你心慈手软地留了他一条性命吧，因度厄？

say:31:1421431026:0.text: Not out of kindness. His crimes—at least, the ones we uncovered—weren't severe enough to warrant execution.
say:31:1421431026:0.source_cn: 确实，但并非心慈手软，只是他犯下的罪行，至少被我们察知...

say:32:1421431027:1.text: He left Sal'thorin with his men some time ago. Maybe to the surface, maybe into the wilderness. I didn't ask.
say:32:1421431027:1.source_cn: 他前段时间就已经带着他的部下们离开了萨洛克兰，或许是去...

say:33:1421431028:1.text: Hmm... but a man like him, privy to so many secrets, wouldn't just walk away and leave it all behind.
say:33:1421431028:1.source_cn: 嗯……既然我母亲跟他有这些小秘密，他那种忠犬就绝对不会...

say:34:1421431029:1.text: No, no, a loyal dog like Thador must still have his own plans.
say:34:1421431029:1.source_cn: 况且，他那种人也不可能就这么老实地跑得远远的，肯定还有...

say:35:1421431030:1.text: I have an idea. Let's go.
say:35:1421431030:1.source_cn: 我心里有数了，走吧，我们去找找看。

choice:27:0:1.text: Why not ask the person involved?
choice:27:0:1.male: Why not ask the person involved?
choice:27:0:1.female: Why not ask the person involved?

choice:9:1:2.text: But Velara would find uses for it.
choice:9:1:2.male: But Velara would find uses for it.
choice:9:1:2.female: But Velara would find uses for it.
